page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9ae.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T95 processors running at a clock speed of 2.25 GHz. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This server type does not include local storage, meaning storage must be attached externally. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a balanced memory-to-core ratio offers a stable resource density suitable for workloads requiring predictable compute performance without the overhead of specialized hardware like GPUs.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated AMD EPYC cores, the ecs.g9ae.4xlarge is designed for general-purpose workloads. Appropriate use cases include web serving, application servers, enterprise applications, and medium-sized databases that do not require high-performance local storage or GPU acceleration.
